fields.title: Dentō Kusuri Ichiba Oyobi Chiryōin no Eisei Shikaku Shōsho (Medical and Sanitary Qualification Certificate for Traditional Herbal Market)
fields.issuer: Balikpapan Shū Eisei Bu (District Health Bureau)

medical_statement.purpose: Karantina shoki gimu kanryō ni tomonau eisei kijun junsyu no kakunin
medical_statement.condition: Eisei kensa ni gōkaku shi, shisetsu no eisei jōtai wa ryōkō de aru
medical_statement.restriction: Kansenshō bōshi no tame no tsūjō no shidō o junsyu suru koto

fields.remarks: Shoki no kensa karantina gimu o hatashi, eisei kensa ni gōkaku shita tame shōsho o kōfu suru.

claims.fact: Iryō shōsho wa shinseisha ga eisei kijun o mitashite iru koto o shōmei shi, saikai no yōkyū o jijitsu jō sasaeru.
